paragraphs: Introducing Jadwal KRL, a beautifully designed and user-friendly app that puts real-time schedules for Indonesian commuter train lines at your fingertips. Developed with a focus on simplicity and accessibility, Jadwal KRL offers a seamless experience for commuters seeking up-to-date information. With its intuitive station search and saving feature, users can easily access relevant schedule information for their preferred stations, ensuring a hassle-free commuting experience. At the heart of Jadwal KRL lies its ability to connect to a replicated public API, fetching and displaying real-time schedules for Indonesian commuter train lines. Built using Next.js, Jadwal KRL delivers a smooth and responsive user experience. With its deployment on Vercel, Jadwal KRL is more than just an app; it's a public act rooted in the belief that public transportation data should be openly accessible to all. Created by Albl Zulio M and distributed under the AGPLv3 license, Jadwal KRL promotes transparency and encourages the development of robust public transportation data infrastructure.
